name: @onegrid/validate
description: Cross-cell, row-level and sheet-level validation for oneGrid. Composes onto the per-cell validator in @onegrid/core rather than replacing it: row predicates (end_date > start_date), sheet predicates (uniqueness, referential integrity, group sums, row-count bounds), incremental revalidation driven by the formula engine's dependency graph, topological rule ordering with a bounded pass cap that breaks cycles instead of hanging, AbortController-based async rules, and error/warning/info severity with blockCommit semantics.
